title: Directional Geometry and Anisotropy in the Partition Graph
summary: We develop a directional formalism for the partition graph G_n based on several canonical reference sets: the main chain, the self-conjugate axis, the spine, and the boundary framework. For each such set S, the graph distance d_S induces a shell structure and a local trichotomy of edges into inward, outward, and level classes. Passing from edges to paths, we define directional corridors as monotone inward geodesics toward a chosen reference set and prove that every vertex admits at least one.
